faq_a1: Canzi is a great Moroccan app that offers a variety of services such as ordering meals, grocery shopping, or even sending flowers directly to your home.
faq_q2: How does the Canzi app work?
faq_a2: The app connects customers with restaurants and local shops. You can easily place an order through the app, pay online, and track your delivery in real time.
faq_q3: In which cities is the app available?
faq_a3: Currently, the Canzi app is available in several Moroccan cities, and the service coverage is continuously expanding.
faq_q4: How can I order food or groceries through the app?
faq_a4: You can easily order food or groceries through the Canzi app by browsing the menu, selecting products, and completing your order using the available payment methods.
faq_q5: Are there any additional fees when using the app?
faq_a5: Service or delivery fees may apply depending on the type of order and the distance, and all costs are displayed before confirming the order.
faq_q6: Can I modify or cancel my order after placing it?
faq_a6: Yes, you can modify or cancel your order within a short period after placing it, according to the store or restaurant policies
faq_q7: What are the requirements to work as a driver?
faq_a7: You must have a valid driver’s license, a suitable vehicle, and a smartphone to receive orders.
faq_q8: What benefits will I get as a partner?
faq_a8: You can expand your business reach, access more customers, and benefit from electronic payment and marketing services.
faq_q9: How can I join Canzi as a partner (restaurant/store)?
faq_a9: If you own a restaurant or store, you can register through the website or the app, and our team will contact you to activate your account.

sale_terms_subtitle: Transparent rules for ordering, delivery, payments and using the Canzi platform.
sale_section1_desc: Customers can choose restaurants and products through the Canzi application, add them to their cart, and confirm the order after selecting the delivery address and payment method. Once the order is confirmed, the restaurant starts preparing the order and the delivery driver handles the delivery.
sale_section2_desc: Canzi offers Cash on Delivery (COD). Electronic payment methods may also be available depending on the city and service availability.
sale_section3_desc: Canzi aims to deliver orders as quickly as possible depending on restaurant location, weather conditions, and order volume. Delivery times remain estimated and may vary.
sale_section4_desc: Customers may cancel orders before preparation begins. Once the restaurant confirms preparation, cancellation may no longer be possible. In case of issues, customers can contact Canzi support.
sale_section5_desc: Canzi acts as an intermediary between customers, restaurants, and delivery drivers. The company is not responsible for delays caused by circumstances beyond its control.
sale_section6_desc: Canzi respects user privacy and uses personal data only for processing orders and improving services.
sale_section7_desc: By using the Canzi application, users agree to comply with all applicable laws and avoid fraudulent or abusive use of the platform.
sale_footer_note: By using the Canzi application, you agree to these Terms and Conditions.

privacy_subtitle: Learn how we collect, use, and protect your personal information on Canzi.
privacy_scope_text: we use name and phone number to make appointment to visit you and provide our service.
privacy_collect_text: we don't share data with any third-party.
privacy_legal_basis_text: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data. However, no method of transmission over the internet or electronic storage is 100% secure.
privacy_purpose_text: Correction: You can request corrections to your data send us an email to support@canzitech.com. Deletion: You can request the deletion of your data send us an email to support@canzitech.com.
privacy_sharing_text: We may update this policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page.
privacy_retention_text: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at support@canzitech.com
privacy_security_text:
We implement advanced technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data from unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, or deletion. These measures include full encryption of data during transmission and storage using SSL/TLS protocols and AES-256 standards.

We adopt a limited access policy whereby no employee may access data except within the scope required by their job. We also conduct periodic security audits and penetration tests to detect any potential vulnerabilities and address them before they pose a risk.

Despite the seriousness of the measures taken, absolute security cannot be guaranteed for any electronic system. We therefore recommend that you take your own precautions, such as using strong passwords and not sharing your login credentials with any third party.
privacy_breach_text:
In the event of the discovery of any security breach affecting your personal data, we are committed to notifying the competent regulatory authorities within the legally specified deadline, which does not exceed 72 hours from the moment of discovery.

We are also committed to notifying you directly if the breach poses a high likelihood of risk to your rights and freedoms. The notification will include a description of the nature of the breach, the types of data affected, the measures taken to mitigate its effects, and steps you can take to protect yourself.

We have an incident response plan that is activated as soon as any breach is discovered, including isolating the affected systems, analyzing the scope of the breach, restoring data from backups, and strengthening security measures to prevent recurrence.
privacy_cookies_text:
We use cookies and similar technologies to improve your experience on our platform, remember your preferences, and analyze usage patterns. Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit our website.

11.1 Types of cookies used:
Essential: necessary for the website to function properly and cannot be disabled
Functional: save your preferences such as language and time zone
Analytical: help us understand how you use the website
Marketing: used to display advertisements relevant to your interests

You can control cookies through your browser settings or via the cookie preferences panel available on our website. Disabling certain types of cookies may affect the performance of certain functions on the platform.
privacy_updates_text:
We reserve the right to amend this policy at any time to keep pace with changes in our practices, legal requirements, or technical developments. The date of the last update will be indicated at the top of the page.

In the event of material changes to this policy, we will notify you via your registered email address or through a prominent notice within the application at least 30 days before the amendments come into effect.

Your continued use of our services after the amendments take effect constitutes implicit acceptance of the updated policy. If you do not agree to the amendments, you have the right to terminate your account, stop using our services, and request the deletion of your data.
privacy_contact_text:
If you have any questions or concerns regarding this Privacy Policy or our data processing practices, we are happy to hear from you through the following channels:
